description: Ministry of  Higher Education -  Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 1603/35 of 28.05.2009 which Specifies the Faculties & Department of the University of Sri Jayawardenepura
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of a legal schedule under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made by the Minister using statutory powers to modify the structure of a university by repealing and adding faculties and departments. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and legal amendments, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While a minister is named, the core content is about legal/regulatory changes to university structure rather than government personnel matters or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
